plainText:
Volume 21: I Want to Let Him Know is the twenty-first volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga and the seventh of eight volumes in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

==Blurb==
While battling formidable opponents Legendary Pokémon Kyogre and Groudon, Ruby and Sapphire recall childhood experiences that shaped their dreams—and pushed them away from other dreams. What is the mysterious connection between their two memories?

And what is the clue to awakening three Pokémon who just might be able to save the day...?

==Important events==
 
Wallace becomes the champion of the Elite Four.
The Red Orb and the Blue Orb are forced out of Maxie and Archie.

==Party changes==
===Additions===

Sapphire's Minun, in PS256. 
===Evolutions===
Sapphire's "Rono" evolves into in PS256.
Ruby's "Rara" evolves into in PS258.

==Gym battles==
Sapphire defeats Tate and Liza together with Ruby in PS257.
Sapphire defeats Juan in PS257.

==Pokémon Contests==
Ruby doesn't participate in any Pokémon Contests.

==Trivia==
This volume has connecting cover art with the next volume.
